verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਿਟੇ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv gursikh sa(n)dh mile pa(n)ch parapa(n)ch miTe pa(n)ch paradhaane hai ||

en.bdb: With the meeting of Guru and Sikh, and engrossment of the latter in the divine word, he is able to counter the deceit of five vices-kam, krodh, lobh, moh and ahankar. The five virtues of Truth, Contentment, Compassion, Devotion and Patience become paramount in his life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭੇਦ ਕਾਲ ਅਉ ਕਰਮ ਖੇਦ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaage bhai bharam bhedh kaal aau karam khedh log bedh ula(n)gh udhot gur giaane hai ||

en.bdb: All his doubts, fear and discriminatory feelings are destroyed. He is not hunted by the worldly discomforts those accrue from worldly activities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣਝੁਣ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maiaa aau braham sam dhasam dhuaar paar anahadh runajhun baajat neesaane hai ||

en.bdb: With his conscious awareness firmly lodged in the mystical tenth opening, the worldly attractions and Lord appears alike to him. He sees the image of the Lord in every creature of the world. And in such a state, he remains engrossed in the celestial music that he hears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: aunaman magan gagan jagamag jot nijhar apaar dhaar param nidhaane hai ||29||

en.bdb: In such a high spiritual state, he enjoys heavenly bliss and the divine light shines in him. He is ever relishing the divine elixir of Naam. (29)
